feature: The panel keeps one main action per section
summary: The right hand panel now reads what the picked thing is. A sound's Flatten button, the Captions section's Earlier, Later, Export and Clear, and the Clear, Reset and readouts on the caption track's bar are gone. Each one is on the right-click of the thing it acts on and in the menu bar. Each section keeps its one main action (Normalize, Rewrite, Copy Measurement, Key It).
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/the-panel-keeps-one-main-action-walk.json

try.do: In a screenshot, press I, measure a distance, press V. The Measurement section keeps Copy Measurement as its one button.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Open a recording and click its clip. The panel lists what the clip is, with no one-shot buttons.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Add music and type 1.5 into Fades In. Channel reads Points, 2 on the bar, with no Flatten button. Gain keeps Normalize.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Right-click the music's volume line and choose Flatten Level (also Clip > Flatten Level).
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Check the line is flat and the Points row has gone.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Pick the Captions track. The section has Rewrite and the look rows, with no Timing or Subtitles. The bar over the timeline reads CAPTION TRACK and nothing else.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Right-click a caption and open More: Timing, Export Subtitles, Reset Captions and Clear Captions are there. The menu bar has Captions Earlier and Later (Option Shift Left and Right), Export Captions, Reset Captions and Clear Captions.

evaluate: Does the sound panel feel calmer with Points as a plain count and Flatten Level on the line's right-click?
With Timing gone from the panel, do you find Captions Earlier and Later (Option Shift arrows) when a recogniser runs late?
Is the caption track's bar still worth its row now that it only says CAPTION TRACK and how the words were written, or should it go too?
Is Copy Measurement right as the Measurement section's one button?
rough: The captions mock draws Clear, Reset, the word being said and the time on the caption track's bar (video-captions.html .tlbar). They are gone, per the answered card the-panel-shows-what-the-picked-thing-is-and-its-how-many-buttons-may-the-right-h (taken as recommended 2026-10-20).
The bar now has an empty band to the right of CAPTION TRACK. I left it because the timeline's rows line up under it.
Flatten Level, Clear Captions, Reset Captions and Export Captions have menu bar rows with no key. Neither Premiere nor Final Cut gives these a key, so I gave them none.
Normalize keeps its Clean noise checkbox under it. That is a setting of Normalize, not a second verb.
Flatten Level from the right-click used to leave the right-clicked segment picked, so Fades said Segment: Mixed for a line with no segments. Flatten now drops that pick.
